Locker Wars · item bank

Everything that can turn up in a unit

All 121 items the game can place in a locker, with the procedural prefab each one builds, its base appraisal range in game dollars, how rare it is, and what it can be hidden under. Colours vary per locker, so each render shows one sample instance.

Concealments

7 cover types

Roughly a third to two thirds of each locker is concealed. A cover's size always matches the item under it, but its identity is only decided after the hammer falls.

Cardboard box

box

Taped cardboard box. Hides small items, sometimes valuables.

Wooden crate

crate

Slatted wooden crate. Hides medium items.

Locked safe

safe

Locked steel safe. Only ever holds small valuables, so rivals bid it up.

Suitcase

suitcase

Latched suitcase. Hides small items, including valuables.

Trash bag

bag

Knotted trash bag. Hides soft goods such as clothing and plush toys.

Tarp-covered lump

tarp

Draped tarp. Can hide anything from a box fan to a motorcycle; its size is the only clue.

Blanket-covered shape

blanket

Moving blanket thrown over a medium or large shape.
